conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="build" AND severity>=ERROR AND NOT protoPayload.methodName:"BuildTrigger" AND NOT protoPayload.methodName:"GitHubInstallation" AND NOT protoPayload.methodName:"GlobalTriggerSettings"

documentation.content:
A Cloud Build run FAILED. Deploys do not happen on a red build, so the merged code is NOT live until this is fixed.

This alert exists because the FC-031 dashboard overhaul sat undeployed for 11 days (2026-07-07 -> 2026-07-18) after a red build went unnoticed.

Triage:
  gcloud builds list --limit=5
  gcloud builds log <BUILD_ID>

Then check whether the live revision matches the intended commit:
  gcloud run revisions list --service=options-wheel-dashboard --region=us-central1 --limit=1
  gcloud run revisions list --service=options-wheel-strategy --region=us-central1 --limit=1
